Name: LeiAili's Revisions for Seasonal Outfits - Elliott
Author: LeiAili
Description:
This mod revises Elliott's portraits from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url].﻿ I love the outfits added by that mod, but they used a previous version of Elliott's portraits from before the game was finalized, and I prefer the look of the normal portrait from the game. So, I made my own portraits by merging the two, so that Elliott can now sport his fancy new clothes while still keeping his smug, Fabio-esque attitude we all know and love.

I'm not exactly a digital artist, but since pixel art is relatively simple, I think they turned out pretty good. Though, the hats for the winter outdoors and Spirit's Eve outfits were tricky, since the portrait from Seasonal Outfits faces forwards more than the vanilla portrait does, so those might look just a little wonky.

All credit for the original mod and portraits goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].

[b][size=3]YOU MUST INSTALL SEASONAL OUTFITS MOD FIRST IN ORDER FOR THIS MOD TO WORK.[/size]

[/b]
[size=5]Changes included:[/size]

[list]
[*]Updated Elliott's portraits for spring, summer, fall, winter indoors, winter outdoors, Spirit's Eve, and Flower Dance.
[*]Beach portrait was not updated, since the outfit used is the same as in the vanilla game. The portrait from Seasonal Outfits must be deleted to use the vanilla one instead - see installation instructions below for details.
[*]Sprites were not updated, since they already match the portraits.
[/list]  
[size=5]Installation:[/size]
 [list]
[*][b]DO NOT USE A MOD MANAGER. [/b]Download mod manually and unzip.
[*]Copy the "assets" folder into the Seasonal Outfits mod folder (most likely C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters) and overwrite all changes.
[*]To use the vanilla beach portrait, open the same folder mentioned above. Go to \assets\Portraits\Beach and delete the file named Elliott_Beach.png.
[*]To use the vanilla beach sprite as well, go to \assets\Characters\Beach and delete the file named Elliott_Beach.png. This will remove the ponytail that the Seasonal Outfits mod gave him.
[*]Run game as normal
[/list] 
 
Hope you enjoy my mod! Please feel free to comment if you have any feedback, or if something doesn't work. Thank you!
